I wanted to remind you that your lease is due to end soon because we know how life can just seem to get in the way of these types of things.

For your benefit, I would like to schedule a visit to our showroom to meet with your Vehicle Specialist so we can do a pre-Inspection on your lease return. At that time, you can look at all the new models and test drive the vehicle you like. This should give you enough time to pick out a new vehicle in the color combination you would prefer.

What does your schedule look this week?

Sincerely,
